title: Larkspur Card Surcharge Schedule by Property State (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Schedule.** For Closing and Funding funding-month interest, the card convenience percentage follows Larkspur's card surcharge schedule for the property's state on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File:

| Property's state on the loan file | Card convenience percentage |
|---|---|
| CT, MA or ME (Larkspur adds no card surcharge) | zero |
| CO | 2.0 percent |
| any other state | 2.5 percent |

The state read is the property state recorded on the Mortgage Loan File.
